subject: Request: temporary hybrid SKU bridge + renewal incentive (SkyBridge AI)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary hybrid SKU bridge + renewal incentive (SkyBridge AI)

Team — quick summary, attaching the MAP and the customer's cost model for context. SkyBridge (Maya / Samir) are live on Dedicated (H200 family) but hit an unexpected procurement embargo on H200 SKUs in their cloud region; they want a short-term path to keep latency targets while we shift some capacity to H100-class instances (hybrid SKU bridge).

Their asks: 
- Allow up to 6 weeks of temporary H200->H100 substitution for up to 40% of reserved capacity
- Reservation hold for 2 weeks while they finalize internal approvals (no termination while hold active)
- Cap overage billing at 1.3x list for the first 90 days after substitution
- A one-time renewal credit / incentive at renewal in exchange for a 12+ month renewal commitment (they're asking for ~10% off renewal)

What's at stake: customer is doing a multi-region rollout; churn here is material and the deal is on track to be a 1.5M ARR committed customer in Yr1 if we keep them. I think offering a temporary substitution + disciplined overage cap + a conditional renewal credit gets us to a keep.

Asking for executive signoff on the concession package below (summary in body):
- Approve temporary SKU substitution (H200 -> H100) for max 6 weeks, up to 40% of reserved capacity
- Reservation hold: 14 calendar days (no cancellation)
- Overage billing cap: 1.30x list for 90 days (after which standard rates apply)
- Renewal incentive: one-time credit equal to 8% of the committed ARR applied at final renewal if renewal >= 12 months

Attachments: SkyBridge-MAP-v2.pdf, cost-model.xlsx

Next steps: If we have an ok from finance/legal, I'll send an amendment and route to DocuSign and charge a small non-refundable admin fee to cover the hold.

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0108

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary hybrid SKU bridge + renewal incentive (SkyBridge AI)

Thanks Vanessa — got it and read the attachments. My recommended concession package (to present to Marissa for signoff) below — slightly tightened from the customer's ask to limit downside while keeping the deal intact: 

Proposed (deal-desk recommended):
- Temporary SKU substitution (H200 -> H100) for up to 6 weeks, capped at 35% of committed reserved capacity (reduces our exposure)
- Reservation hold: 14 days (customer pays a $7,500 non-refundable admin/hold fee)
- Overage cap: 1.30x list for 60 days, then step to 1.50x list for the following 30 days before reverting to standard rates (adds gradual de-escalation)
- Renewal incentive: 8% one-time credit at renewal if renewal term >= 12 months; credit applied to first invoice after renewal
- Require an SLA addendum that documents acceptable performance ranges for substituted instances and triggers an automatic rollback if 95th latency breaches by >25%

Reasoning: this preserves predictable economics, reduces long tail exposure with the staged overage, and ties the incentive to an enforceable renewal. Finance will need visibility into expected ARR to approve. Legal to draft amendment language.

If everyone is ok, I'd like Marissa to sign off prior to routing to DocuSign.

- Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 13:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary hybrid SKU bridge + renewal incentive (SkyBridge AI)

Quick finance take — numbers in the attached cost-model.xlsx. TL;DR: incremental margin impact is tolerable if we get the renewal commitment.

Notes:
- If deal ARR (committed) >= $1.2M we can accept the staged overage profile as proposed by Rishi. Below that threshold I recommend tightening the cap to 1.20x for the first 30 days and remove the 30-day 1.50x step.
- Admin/hold fee is a must; suggests we collect up-front and lock the reservation hold to preserve runway.
- Suggest limiting credits to one-time and not compounding (explicit in amendment).

I've updated the model with sensitivity rows — see tab "sensitivity_5pct".

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Finance, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary hybrid SKU bridge + renewal incentive (SkyBridge AI)

Looping in Marissa for exec signoff on the economics. A couple legal items for the amendment/docusign packet: 

1) Add a defined "Temporary Substitution Period" (start/end dates) and require SkyBridge to notify 72 hours before any substitution begins.
2) Include explicit language that the reservation hold prevents cancellation but does not defer payment obligations (we should still collect the admin fee).
3) Add a clause that credits are conditional on no outstanding breaches at renewal and that credits are non-refundable.
4) Require that the amendment be executed via DocuSign and that the renewal trigger is a signed renewal agreement (not a silent renewal).

I've started a draft amendment (draft-amendment.docx) and linked it in the HubSpot deal record. Once Marissa approves economics, I'll finalize redlines and route to DocuSign.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com

Appreciate the clear summary and the tightened proposal. Approved with the following changes (to limit downside while allowing SkyBridge to proceed):

1) Approve Temporary Substitution (H200 -> H100) for up to 6 weeks and up to 35% of reserved capacity.
2) Reservation hold: 14 days; collect the $7.5k non-refundable admin fee up-front.
3) Overage cap: cap at 1.25x list for the first 45 days, then 1.50x for the next 15 days, then revert to standard rates. (Slightly tighter front-loaded cap than recommended.)
4) Renewal incentive: approve an 8% one-time credit at renewal; credit is contingent on signed renewal >= 12 months and no outstanding breaches.
5) Legal to finalize amendment; Finance to confirm modeled margin impact and collect admin fee before amendment execution.

Rishi — you have signoff to proceed. Lauren/Vanessa, please finalize the amendment, get DocuSign executed, and confirm the upfront admin fee has hit the ledger before applying the reservation hold. Coordinate with Karthik for the cost-model confirmation and with Ops to tag the reservation for the temporary substitution window.
